alert_news.title: Sawan Barwal Ends 44‑Year Wait, Wins India's First Asian Games Marathon Medal Since 1982
bullets: India's first Asian Games marathon medal in 44 years, silver won by Sawan Barwal at the 2026 Asian Games
Time 2:11:37, setting a new national record

alert_news.title: First Ascent Mountaineering Expedition in Ladakh
bullets: India’s first-ever ascent of 20 unclimbed peaks above 6,000 m in Ladakh, achieved by a 20‑member team from the National Institute of Mountaineering and Adventure Sports (NIMAS) under the Ministry of Defence
The expedition covered 20 peaks in 23 days, led by Colonel Ranveer Singh Jamwal, marking a national first in high‑altitude mountaineering

alert_news.title: IIT Delhi Develops India's First Micro‑GPU
bullets: India’s first working indigenous micro‑Graphics Processing Unit (micro‑GPU) developed by IIT Delhi’s Electrical Engineering Department in Delhi.
Engine built entirely in Register Transfer Language (RTL) and mapped to a Spartan‑7 FPGA, featuring a custom floating‑point GPU core for embedded graphics.

alert_news.title: India's First Victim Rights Centre Inaugurated at Patna by CJI Surya Kant
bullets: India’s first Victim Rights Centre established under Section 12 of the Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987, located at Bihar State Legal Services Authority (BSLSA), Patna, inaugurated by Chief Justice Surya Kant.

The centre offers a single‑window system for victims to access legal aid, medical treatment, FIR copies, bail participation, compensation and protection measures, coordinating with police, hospitals, welfare committees and state departments.
Operates as a pilot project without creating a new statutory body, leveraging existing infrastructure and personnel.

alert_news.title: India's First Coastal Green Shipping Corridor to Operate Weekly Container Service
bullets: India’s first Coastal Green Shipping Corridor links Kandla (Deendayal Port Authority, Gujarat) with V.O. Chidambaranar (VOC) Port, Thoothukudi (Tamil Nadu), inaugurated by the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways in 2025.
The corridor will run a dedicated weekly two‑way container service with vessels of minimum 1,000 TEU capacity, promoting greener maritime transport and green‑fuel infrastructure along the route.

Project cost estimated at ₹150 crore, managed by Indian Port Rail & Ropeway Corporation Ltd. (IPRCL) in partnership with Shipping Corporation of India, Deendayal Port Authority and VOC Port Authority.

alert_news.title: Jay Meena wins India's first ever soft tennis bronze medal at Asian Games
bullets: India's first soft tennis medal at the Asian Games, won by Jay Meena in Nagoya 2024
Bronze medal in men's singles, marking India's inaugural soft tennis podium finish at a continental multi‑sport event
